intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} programmes in {{cityA}}. This page compares recorded year tuitions, 2023 placements and India Today ranks from our database and official sites opened in {{year}}.
Mount Carmel College vs The Oxford College of Science is a local Bangalore science-master's comparison. The subject lists overlap in biotechnology, but they are not identical.

sections.heading: Mount Carmel College vs The Oxford College of Science for MSc: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Mount Carmel College if you want the recorded year tuition of ₹89,000 and the 2023 biotechnology record of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest, with India Today ranks of 22 in 2024 and 21 in 2023.

Choose The Oxford College of Science if you want the recorded year tuition of ₹75,000 and the 2023 apparel-technology record of ₹4 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest, after you confirm the official notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For Mount Carmel College we hold ₹89,000 as tuition for one year across the listed MSc programmes. That is a year figure, not a confirmed two-year official total.
For The Oxford College of Science we hold ₹75,000 as tuition for one year across the listed MSc programmes, including biotechnology, microbiology, biochemistry, mathematics and statistics.
Confirm the current notices on mccblr.edu.in and theoxfordscience.org before you budget.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Mount Carmel has a 2023 M.Sc Biotechnology row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹8 lakh highest. The Oxford College of Science has a 2023 apparel-technology row of ₹4 lakh average and ₹9 lakh highest.
These are historical records for those streams, not a promise for every MSc subject. Ask both campuses for a later official report if you need branch-wise 2025 figures.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: The Oxford College of Science is listed with CMAT on this page, which is unusual for an MSc, so confirm the official admissions process before you apply. Mount Carmel has no exam mapped here.
On our records, Mount Carmel has India Today ranks of 22 in 2024 and 21 in 2023. The Oxford College of Science has India Today ranks of 58 in 2024 and 55 in 2023. These are not NIRF ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are private colleges in Bangalore, so a local student can visit the labs on the same trip.
Mount Carmel College is a women's college. The Oxford College of Science is a co-educational science campus. That campus culture may matter as much as the ₹14,000 year-tuition gap.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick Mount Carmel College if the women's campus, the higher India Today ranks, and the recorded ₹89,000 year tuition fit your plan.
Pick The Oxford College of Science if the recorded ₹75,000 year tuition and that science campus are the better fit, after official confirmation.
Match the exact MSc subject first, because the 2023 placement rows belong to biotechnology and apparel technology, not to every listed programme.
